# Strategy Advisors

> > Strategy Advisors provides capital market consulting, corporate governance advisory, and investment strategy research for Japanese and international markets.

Strategy Advisors is a Tokyo-based consulting firm specializing in capital market strategy, activist defense, and corporate governance for listed companies. The firm combines deep financial research with executive advisory services across Japanese equity markets.

## Key Topics

- corporate governance
- capital market consulting
- activist defense
- equity strategy
- IR strategy
- stock price optimization
- investment strategy
- market analysis
- Japanese stocks
- sponsored research
- executive training
- financial commentary
- research reports
- TSE-listed companies
- financial capital markets

## Core Services & Overview

- [Strategy Advisors Homepage](https://www.strategy-advisors.co.jp/): Capital market consulting and corporate governance advisory firm serving Japanese listed companies and international investors

## Research & Analysis

- [Research Reports](https://www.strategy-advisors.co.jp/report/): In-depth research reports on Japanese TSE-listed companies covering financial analysis, equity strategy, and market insights

## Insights & Commentary

- [Company Columns](https://www.strategy-advisors.co.jp/column/): Expert columns on investment strategy, market analysis, corporate governance, and capital market trends
